market.selection: Initial same-contract header capture; its actual UTC timestamp and original fields are preserved. Later headers are supplementary.

latest_captured_market.selection: Last fresh same-contract header; does not replace or backfill the primary snapshot.

time_semantics.observation_timestamps: Actual UTC capture timestamps retained exactly; archive hour 15 UTC.
time_semantics.chart_labels: Verbatim displayed chart labels with unknown timezone; no venue UTC inference.
time_semantics.bar_status: Explicit current-run running captures establish displayed interval boundaries. Selected interval controls are capture-coordinator attested. Prior hours must exist as valid raw completed candles.
time_semantics.synchronization: Asynchronous public UI snapshots, not synchronized venue events.

open_interest.selection_note: Latest capture of each distinct actual chart label; latest two distinct displayed hours only. Capture UTC is not chart event UTC.

candles.sensitivity_bounds_note: Conservative +/- one full displayed increment sensitivity only, not a verified exchange rounding rule.

running_1h.interval_classification_basis: Selected 1H/4H control visually verified by capture coordinator; actual displayed labels determine candle sequence, not raw kind.
running_1h.running_interval_attestation: Capture coordinator verified post-reload 1h running candle; actual displayed raw08 label is preserved even though raw kind is recovery_current.

closed_4h.interval_classification_basis: Selected 1H/4H control visually verified by capture coordinator; actual displayed labels determine candle sequence, not raw kind.

running_4h.interval_classification_basis: Selected 1H/4H control visually verified by capture coordinator; actual displayed labels determine candle sequence, not raw kind.

all_valid_candle_captures.running_interval_attestation: Capture coordinator verified post-reload 1h running candle; actual displayed raw08 label is preserved even though raw kind is recovery_current.

all_observed_candle_captures.running_interval_attestation: Capture coordinator verified post-reload 1h running candle; actual displayed raw08 label is preserved even though raw kind is recovery_current.

candles.closed_1h_revision_note: All actual same-label reads are preserved. The latest valid observed revision supplies current calculations. A changed displayed close or volume is recorded without asserting its cause; chart timezone remains unknown.

predicted.conversion: Displayed percent divided by 100; current header funding estimate, not a settled payment.

funding.historical_note: Timestamped chart-local history is distinct from predicted header funding. Unknown chart timezone prevents UTC settlement assignment; no account payment is inferred.

undated_historical_chart_label_captures.limitation: Undated historical-chart label only; no timestamped historical point, UTC settlement, or latest-settled status can be established. Kept separate from the predicted funding header.

latest_undated_historical_chart_label.limitation: Undated historical-chart label only; no timestamped historical point, UTC settlement, or latest-settled status can be established. Kept separate from the predicted funding header.

visible_depth.selection: Five visible levels on each side from the actual primary capture only; no cross-capture assembly or later replacement.

mark_prior_hour_comparison.limitation: Actual observation-to-observation UTC gap retained; approximately hourly means 45–75 minutes. No interpolation or rescaling to an exact one-hour return. Prior values are used only for this labelled comparison.

research_threshold_scope: JCTUSDT specified gates only. STRKUSDT and KAIAUSDT are informational and cannot independently trigger an alert. Three contracts do not represent the whole market.

quality.taker_volume_formatting_note: Rounding versus truncation is unknown. Half-increment sensitivity is informational; only gaps exceeding a full candle display increment are flagged as unexplained.
limitations: Unknown venue/chart timezone and event timestamps.
Running bars excluded from completed-bar conclusions.
Compact quantities are approximate; rounding versus truncation is unknown.
Historical funding points do not prove UTC settlement or account payment.
No account-state or order-entry information is included.

capture_session_diagnostics.result: Genuine partial archive after bounded public-UI retries; missing data remains explicit.
capture_session_diagnostics.recovery_attempts: One STRK reload recovered quantity-OI capture. JCT and STRK research tabs were later closed. One KAIA reload restored a running 1h display, but mouse control remained unreliable.

quality.ui_connection_status_note: Exact public UI labels and their actual capture timestamps are preserved separately from the sanitized market snippet. A Stable connection label does not prove event freshness, and a Disconnected label does not establish its cause or exchange-feed delay. Supplemental warnings never replace primary observations; readings with a warning retain that qualification.

raw_capture_index_scope: Zero-based global index in the current-run combined raw capture array.
